messages:
lina (Product): Quick sync — we need to finalize the Dedicated autoscale policy and launch criteria for Q2 planning.

mike_eng (Eng): What are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? Can we scope a minimal safe default?

lina (Product): Must-haves: deterministic eviction behavior, SLA mapping to tier, opt-in burst window, and clear rollout plan. Nice-to-have: per-customer burst budgets, soft quotas dashboard.

casey_cs (CS): Customer ask: finance platform startup wants guaranteed isolation for peak trading windows; they're willing to sign a 12mo commit if we provide hard isolation lane + 1s tail latency SLA.

devon_sre (SRE): Suggested SLOs: p95 < 500ms for dedicated small models, p99 tail < 2s for dedicated with burst enabled. Eviction: prefer 'evict-oldest-prefill' with graceful 5s drain. We'll need rejection codes to surface to clients.

sophia_finance (Finance): If we add hard isolation lanes, we should attach a premium line item. Also need to model reserved capacity utilization impact on revenue — estimate +8-12% uplift if priced correctly.

mike_eng (Eng): Implementation notes: autoscaler needs an isolation flag, burst token bucket per-customer, and fallback routing to compatible model variants. Rough estimate: 4 wks engineering + 1 wk testing for alpha; +2 wks for canary & metrics.

lina (Product): Proposed default policy snippet (for discussion):
```
{
  "isolation": "soft",
  "max_burst_seconds": 30,
  "burst_token_rate": 10,
  "eviction_policy": "evict-oldest-prefill",
  "sla_tier": "standard"
}
```

devon_sre (SRE): For hard isolation lane default we should require operator opt-in and a dedicated pool capacity check. Also add a circuit-breaker that rejects bursts when utilization > 85%.

lina (Product): Launch criteria checklist draft:
- define SLA Tiers & SLAs
- implement token-bucket burst gating
- eviction + drain behaviour implemented and tested
- metrics: per-tenant burst usage, queue-depth, reject-rate
- billing hook for isolation premium
- canary with 3 customers

casey_cs (CS): I can line up 2 customers for canary (one trading, one adtech). Will confirm SLAs they need.

mike_eng (Eng): I'll pair with SRE for rollout playbook. Need a little more clarity on reject codes and client retry semantics.

deploy-bot: PR #4923 opened: feature/autoscale-isolation (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4923)

lina (Product): Okay — action items: Mike + Devon: finalize policy + metrics (ETA 1w). Sophia: pricing delta model (ETA 1w). Casey: confirm canary customers (ETA 2w). We'll review in next product sync. :thumbsup:
